Package model

Class Calendar

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.Calendar
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ICalendar
    public class Calendar
extends java.lang.Object
implements ICalendar
    Defines the implementation of the calendar interface. This represents a calendar which cannot accept recurring events to be created if they are conflicting with other events.

    • Method Detail

      • createEvent

        public void createEvent​(java.lang.String subject,
                        java.time.LocalDateTime startDateTime,
                        java.time.LocalDateTime endDateTime,
                        java.lang.String description,
                        java.lang.String location,
                        java.lang.Boolean isPrivate,
                        boolean autoDecline)
                 throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Description copied from interface: ICalendar
        Create an event based on the parameters that are passed to it.The name, start date time and end date time of an event together uniquely identify an event. These are mandatory fields.
        Specified by:
        createEvent in interface ICalendar
        Parameters:
        subject - describes the name of the event which cannot be null. Name of the event can be same for different events.
        startDateTime - describes the start date and start time of a particular event. This field cannot be null since it describes when the event starts.
        endDateTime - describes the end date and end time of an event. This field cannot be null since it defines when an event ends.
        description - provides the detailed description of an event. This field is can be null which means user may choose to provide the description for an event.
        location - describes address of the event. This field is can be null which means user may choose to provide the location for an event.
        isPrivate - defines if the event is going to be public or private. If true is passed then the event is categorized as private otherwise public. This field can be null.
        autoDecline - defines whether the event should be created or declined based on conflicting events. If true is passed then the event would not be created if it is conflicting with another event,otherwise event will be created. If false is passed then the event will be created even if conflicting with other events.
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - When subject,end date time and start date time fields are null. When start date time is defined after end date time.

      • createRecurringEventWithOccurrences

        public void createRecurringEventWithOccurrences​(java.lang.String subject,
                                                java.time.LocalDateTime startDateTime,
                                                java.time.LocalDateTime endDateTime,
                                                java.lang.String description,
                                                java.lang.String location,
                                                java.lang.Boolean isPrivate,
                                                java.lang.String daysOfWeek,
                                                int occurrences)
                                         throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Description copied from interface: ICalendar
        Create a recurring event that repeats for specified amount of times. The subject,start time date and end date time, days of week, number of occurrences are mandatory fields. This calendar does not allow recurring events to span for multiple days.
        Specified by:
        createRecurringEventWithOccurrences in interface ICalendar
        Parameters:
        subject - describes the name of the event which cannot be null. Name of the event can be same for different events.
        startDateTime - describes the start date and start time of the recurring event series in the series.This field cannot be null since it describes when the event starts.
        endDateTime - describes the end date and end time of a particular event in the series. This field cannot be null since it defines when an event ends.
        description - provides the detailed description of an event. This field is can be null which means user may choose to provide the description for an event.
        location - describes where the event is going to be held.This field is can be null which means user may choose to provide the location for an event.
        isPrivate - defines if the event is going to be public or private. If true is passed then the event is categorized as private otherwise public. This field can be null.
        daysOfWeek - defines on which week day the event repeats. This field cannot be null. The following letters define the week days from Monday to Sunday. Monday - 'M' ,Tuesday 'T',Wednesday-'W',Thursday-'R',Friday -'F', Saturday-'S',Sunday-'U'.
        occurrences - defines the number of times the event must be repeated. This field cannot be null
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if any of subject ,start date time ,end date time , days of week for occurrences is null. When number of occurrences is less than or equal to 0. When start date time is after the end date time.
